description: This file defines the SpdyBuffer class used for managing data buffers in SPDY protocol connections, including methods for consuming data, callbacks, and buffer management.

classes.name: SpdyBuffer
classes.description: A class to hold and manage data buffers for SPDY protocol communication, with callback mechanisms for data consumption.

methods.name: SpdyBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a SPDY serialized frame.

methods.name: SpdyBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with raw data.

methods.name: AddConsumeCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when data is consumed.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes a specified number of bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: GetRemainingData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the remaining unconsumed data.

methods.name: GetRemainingSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the remaining unconsumed data.

methods.name: GetIOBufferForRemainingData
methods.description: Provides an IOBuffer pointing to the remaining data for use in socket write operations.
